name: rho
title: Rho functions
description:
This function returns the value of the "rho" loss function used
to compute either an M-scale estimator or a robust regression
estimator. It currently can be used to compute the bisquare, optimal
and modified optimal loss functions.
usage: rho(u, family = " bisquare", cc, standardize = TRUE)

arguments.description: point or vector at which rho is to be evaluated

family string specifying the name of the family of loss function to be used (current valid
options are "bisquare", "opt" and "mopt").

tuning parameters to be computed according to efficiency and / or breakdown
considerations. See `lmrobdet.control`, `bisquare`, `mopt`
and `opt`.

logical value determining whether the rho function is to be
standardized so that its maximum value is 1. See `Mpsi`.

examples_r:
# Evaluate rho tuned for 85\% efficiency
rho(u=1.1, family='bisquare', cc=bisquare(.85))
# Evaluate rho tuned for 50\% breakdown
rho(u=1.1, family='opt', cc=lmrobdet.control(bb=.5, family='opt')$tuning.chi)
author: Matias Salibian-Barrera, <matias@stat.ubc.ca>
